notes.title: Update #5
notes.notes:
Changelog : 

 *  Added real-time challanges

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/286846ed18b70eaf5a32a8cd5d1e9635b9b22fde.png

 *  Random event algorithm has been improved.

 *  Comment System has been added. Now you will be able to read the comments you have received after the games you have made if you have internet access.

 *  The economic balance has been improved.

 *  Fixed a money bug that occurs when you try to buy modem level 2.

 *  If you encounter any problem please create a topic at Discussions. <3

notes.title: Hotfix #8
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


 *  Added a system that saves cargo-boxes. You can find your all boxes in front of your Villa when you enter the game.

 *  Door mechanics have been improved.

 *  The economic balance has been improved.

 *  Atmospheric experience has been improved.

 *  Minor localization bugs have been fixed.

 *  Fixed a rare bug that causes negative money count.

notes.title: Hotfix #7
notes.notes:
Changelog : 

* The economic balance has been improved. The coefficients of the technologies have been increased.

* Removed an unnecessary feature that occurs when you pay the water bill

* Minor localization bugs have been fixed.

* Specific computier powers has been improved.

* The information panel at the start of the game has been updated.

* Fixed a timing bug that occurs when the video-tutorial starts.

notes.title: Hotfix #6
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Fixed a rare bug that destroys your save file and blocks TAB Menu, Cradle Board mechanics and etc.

* Footstep sound effects were too loud. Footstep SFX's volume were decreased.

* Added an indicator that indicates you to keep debugging phase long.

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Fixed a lots of bugs that occurs when you try to research audio technologies.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Realistic Wind.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Food Packs.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Flag Textures.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Object Animations.

* Minor localization bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update #5
notes.notes:
Changelog : 



 *  Copyright infringement system has been added. Now, when you produce games with the names of well-known games, you have to pay copyright infringement penalties.

 *  Added new indicators. You can learn how to make better games from your old games now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/41d024aa497884457d2871e7ddd74b2524f73ad9.png

 *  You can inflate the market when you publish the same type of game consecutively now.

 *  Fixed a bug that let you hit high points with buggy games.

 *  Fixed a bug that never let you gain enough fans from the adverts.

 *  Fixed a bug that causes to not reduce game production time when you upgrade setups.

 *  Solved a problem that occurs when there is no snacks on left in the basket.

 *  Economic balance is improved but still in the testing phase.

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
Changelog : 





 The turntable has been added. Now you will be able to choose and listen to the original musics of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/b4fdd27e2fe47dbf6216394cc4ce0907b9bf1f48.png

 Several high-quality terrain textures have been added.

 The prices of the advice books were reduced.

 Fixed a bug that causes variable missing on the save file.

 Bloom effect in some materials has been reworked.

 Fixed a emissive light bug that occurs when you save your game at the late hours.

 Added new indicators that notice you how to detach setups/chairs from tables.

 Added blur effect.

 The lampshade on the upper floor of the villa has been removed, the constant light has been added.

  Added Ambient Occlusion effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/2331f4a5328fef02c8fa17969d0365afdca75dc8.png

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Economic balance is improved.

* Fixed a exit problem that occurs when you open the fridge.

* Now you lose more fans when you create bad games.

* Added  automatic save system. Now the game will be automatically saved right after publishing a game.

* Added a new fence door near the General Store.

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Fixed a bug that occurs when you choose cleaning at the beginning.

* Visual technology costs were reduced.

* Fixed a bug that occurs graphical problem in the Villa.

* Fixed some localization problems.

* Added to do list for villa. It has only 3 level for now. New levels will be added in future updates.

* Fixed a rare bug that instantiates scenario panels randomly on your screen.

* Economic balance is improved.

* Now you lose more fans when you create bad games.

* Cargo horn sound has been changed.

* Added fire sounds to campfire.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
Changelog : 



 Added New Game Modes ! 

 Now, You will be able to choose where you want to start !



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/4d2db0037b3160f8cb3b3c705811d5688ccc95fa.png



 The economic balance has been improved.

 Fixed a bug that occurs when you select strategy theme.

 Electricity and water bills in  the villa were reduced. If you don't pay them in the time, you'll be fined.

 Now, If you pay the water bill, your water dispenser will be automatically refilled.

 Fixed a bug that occurs when theme randomizer picks "Animals" main theme.

 Fixed a rare bug that occurs when the main theme randomizer algorithm run.

 The fan base growth speed has been reduced.

 Fixed a bug that makes you millionaire with a low budget games.

 Added a new tutorial to the villa.

 The game production speed in the villa has been increased.

 Now, you can get hungry and thirsty faster.

 Fixed a rare bug that occurs when you eat something.

 English voice-over for Normal-Mode tutorial will be added next hotfix.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* The number of rents to be paid to move to the villa has been reduced.

* The amount of income required to move to the villa has been reduced.

* The number of main themes that need to be researched to move to the villa has been reduced.

* Upgrade cost of Garage PC has been reduced to 3.000$.

* Environmental money bonuses in the garage have been increased.

* The low-budget games you make in the Villa now let you earn more.

* Fixed a bug that causes minus research points at the Villa.

* Fixed some notification bugs.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Fixed a bug that occured when you try to close skill board with "e" key.

* Removed an panel that shows you how much you earn & how you developt your skills. You will now earn regular income for a short time after receiving the results of your games in the garage.

* Fixed a bug that cause save problem with researched main themes in the Garage.

* A few labels have been added to the General Store in the Villa.

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Fixed a bug that makes your garage unnecessarily dirty.

* The amount of income required to move to the villa has been reduced.

* The number of fans required to move into the villa has been reduced.

* The number of technologies required to move to the villa has been reduced.

* Added a label on how to upgrade your computer in the garage.

* Several localization bugs has been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Changelog : 


* Required revenue to move to villa from the garage has been changed to 30.000.

* Fixed a bug that occured when you bankrupt at garage.

* Fixed a voice over bug when you interact with Garage Owner
